Sandbox_JH_Enabled_tooltip: Enable or disable horde night events.
Sandbox_JH_StartDay_tooltip: The first in-game day horde events can begin.
Sandbox_JH_FrequencyMin_tooltip: Minimum number of days between horde events. The actual interval is randomly chosen between min and max.
Sandbox_JH_FrequencyMax_tooltip: Maximum number of days between horde events. The actual interval is randomly chosen between min and max.
Sandbox_JH_ZombieCount_tooltip: Base number of zombies spawned per online player during a horde event.
Sandbox_JH_ZombieIncrement_tooltip: Additional zombies added to the count after each horde event.
Sandbox_JH_ZombieCountMax_tooltip: Maximum zombies per player regardless of increment stacking.
Sandbox_JH_SpawnDistanceMin_tooltip: Minimum distance (in tiles) from the player where zombies can spawn.
Sandbox_JH_SpawnDistanceMax_tooltip: Maximum distance (in tiles) from the player where zombies can spawn.
Sandbox_JH_SafeRadius_tooltip: Radius (in tiles) around each player that is checked to be clear before spawning.
Sandbox_JH_LureRadius_tooltip: Radius of the sound lure that draws zombies toward players.
Sandbox_JH_LureVolume_tooltip: Volume of the sound lure. Higher values attract zombies from further away.
Sandbox_JH_LureIntervalTicks_tooltip: How often (in game ticks) a lure pulse is emitted during the horde event.
Sandbox_JH_WarnPlayers_tooltip: If enabled, players receive a warning message and moodle before the horde arrives.
Sandbox_JH_SurvivorMultiplierMax_tooltip: Maximum zombie multiplier a player can earn from surviving hordes. Each survival adds +0.1x. Default 15.0 means up to 16x zombies at max.
Sandbox_JH_RottenFleshChance_tooltip: Percentage chance (0-100) that a zombie drops Rotten Flesh when killed. Default 5 means 5% of zombie kills yield the item.
Sandbox_JH_HordeImmunityEnabled_tooltip: If enabled, players can consume Zombie Stew to gain immunity from the current horde event. No zombies will target them and no lure pulses will emit around them.
Sandbox_JH_FragranceEnabled_tooltip: Allow Fragrance A la Jeeves bottles to spawn in the world. When disabled, existing bottles still function but no new ones will appear in loot.
Sandbox_JH_FragranceSpawnRate_tooltip: Relative spawn weight (1 = extremely rare, 100 = common). Default 10. Fragrance spawns at half the vanilla Cologne weight in each location, then scaled by this value.
